label: safe
note: The entrypoint-to-sink path exists as inventory but crosses a sanitiser, so no *unsanitized* path is reported. Scored on attack paths, per the same reasoning as `cross_function`. The sanitised inventory is scored too -- through `clean`, not through tp/fp/fn, since counting inventory as a detection would make this safe case a false positive by construction -- so fabricating taint on it is visible to `interprocedural:case_mismatch_rate`.
